config.shadowdrop.title: Shadow Drop Config
config.shadowdrop.modEnabled.tooltip: Enable or disable drop shadows entirely.
config.shadowdrop.shadowColor.tooltip: Color of shadows as an RGB hex string (e.g. #000000).
config.shadowdrop.shadowAlpha.tooltip: Opacity of shadows (0 is fully transparent, 255 is fully opaque).
config.shadowdrop.shadowXOffset.tooltip: Horizontal distance to the right of each shadow from its item.
config.shadowdrop.shadowYOffset.tooltip: Vertical distance downwards of each shadow from its item.
config.shadowdrop.hotbarShadows.tooltip: Render shadows under items in the hotbar.
config.shadowdrop.slotShadows.tooltip: Render shadows under items in standard 16x16 GUI slots.
config.shadowdrop.hoverShadows.tooltip: Render shadows under items in GUI slots hovered over by the cursor.
config.shadowdrop.cursorShadows.tooltip: Render shadows under items carried by the cursor.
config.shadowdrop.elsewhereShadows.toolt: Render shadows under items elsewhere (in places not listed above).
config.shadowdrop.slotCropped.tooltip: Constrain shadows to standard 16x16 GUI slot borders.
config.shadowdrop.hoverCropped.tooltip: Constrain shadows to the GUI slot border of the hovered item.
config.shadowdrop.translucentItems.toolt: Items that render shadows with reduced opacity (comma-separated item IDs or tags).
config.shadowdrop.transparentItems.toolt: Items that never render shadows (comma-separated item IDs or tags).
config.shadowdrop.offsetItems.tooltip: Slightly push items forward so that shadows can render properly behind them.
